name: io.github.nipdep/agent-overleaf-connector
title: Overleaf for AI agents (olmcp)
description: Overleaf for AI agents: review comments, tracked-change edits, new files and PDFs; no Git needed

environmentVariables.name: OVERLEAF_SESSION
environmentVariables.description: Your Overleaf session cookie (overleaf_session2). Optional: `olmcp auth` stores it in ~/.config/olmcp instead.

environmentVariables.name: OVERLEAF_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Only for a self-hosted Overleaf, e.g. https://overleaf.example.edu. Defaults to https://www.overleaf.com.
